## What I Do
I lead a 30-person cross-functional squad of data engineers, ML engineers, and product managers at Easyrewardz, reporting to the CEO. I own the product roadmap and P&L for the Zence platform — a suite of 10 enterprise data and AI products serving 100M+ customer profiles.

## Core Metrics
- 100M+ real-time customer profiles in Zence CDP
- 13B+ events processed annually (3B SMS + 10B emails)
- 30 engineers and product managers in my squad
- 100+ enterprise clients onboarded in 3 months via OneConsent
- 60% faster insights from Logra RAG analytics pipeline
- $5M to $12M portfolio ARR growth over 6 years

## Products Built (0-to-1)
1. Oliver AI — Agentic commerce AI with voice interface (LangGraph, MCP, Ozonetel, Sarvam AI)
2. Segcon — Real-time customer segmentation at millisecond latency (Kafka, ClickHouse, Polars)
3. Model Studio — Self-serve ML platform for churn/propensity models (Airflow, Vertex AI, Gemini)
4. Zence 360 — Cloud-native Customer Data Platform for 100M+ profiles (Spark, Delta Lake, Azure)
5. Zence Marketing — Campaign automation at 13B+ events/year (Celery, Kafka, Redis)
6. Zence Commerce — Loyalty and rewards commerce layer (FastAPI, MySQL, Kubernetes)
7. OneConsent — Enterprise consent management (OPA, ClickHouse, Kafka)
8. LPaaS — Loyalty-Platform-as-a-Service for mid-market brands
9. Logra — Analytics and RAG-powered query engine (ClickHouse, LangGraph, Gemini)
10. MCP Gateway — Agentic infrastructure for tool-calling AI agents
